enunciado: Given the grades 95, 83, 71, 64 and 40, show the letter for each: A (>= 90), B (>= 80), C (>= 70), D (>= 60) and F otherwise.
objetivos: Order conditions from most to least restrictive
pistas: An else { if (...) } is only evaluated when the previous condition was false.
Since you already know the grade < 90, asking >= 80 is enough for B.
Write a function that returns the letter.
